name: pinball-play
note: A person's start: Play on the title, a pad joins, Start, the table chosen with South, the plunger held a second and let go, then the flippers on the shoulders and the d-pad. The ball's whole path (game.hash) must be the same bits on every host. The control never pulls the plunger.

name: pinball-face
note: The face buttons alone in play, through the real pad path: west the left flipper, east the right, both together, south both once the ball is up (a fresh press), short taps of each, north a nudge. Every press is a flip (game.flips) and the game is the same bits natively and in the dual cart on romdev. The control plays the same start and nudge with no face-button flips: its flips and ball path differ, so it must fail.
